caption: He dressed as a mechanic, a beggar, even a police officer, just to bring people the sacraments. Bl. Miguel Pro died in 1927 forgiving his executioners: "Viva Cristo Rey!" Meet more saints: catholicdoorway.com/saints #Saints #Catholic

image.title: Blessed Miguel Pro
image.body: A Jesuit priest who served Mexico's Catholics in secret and died with arms outstretched, crying “Viva Cristo Rey!”

coach.why: A vivid, true detail in the first line makes people need the rest of the story, and the ending carries real emotion.
fixes: "Send this to someone who needs courage today" would add a share ask if you shorten elsewhere.

alternates.caption: 3 disguises, 1 mission: a Jesuit priest in 1920s Mexico who kept bringing the sacraments to people in hiding. Bl. Miguel Pro's last words: "Viva Cristo Rey!" catholicdoorway.com/saints #Saints #Catholic

"Viva Cristo Rey!" The day after the feast of Christ the King, we remember Bl. Miguel Pro, a Mexican Jesuit who kept bringing the sacraments to people in secret and died forgiving his executioners. Meet more saints: catholicdoorway.com/saints #Catholic #Saints

video.hook: He dressed as a *beggar* to bring people the *sacraments.*

caption: Who's saying grace on Thursday? Here's the one most Catholics learned as kids: "Bless us, O Lord, and these thy gifts, which we are about to receive from thy bounty, through Christ our Lord. Amen." Save it for the table. catholicdoorway.com/prayers #Thanksgiving

image.title: Grace Before Meals
image.body: Bless us, O Lord, and these thy gifts, which we are about to receive from thy bounty, through Christ our Lord. Amen.

coach.why: Everyone has to answer that question in their head this week, and the save ask matches what Instagram rewards.
fixes: Swap the card's kicker to "Save this for Thursday" next time the image is made.

caption: The Church's new year doesn't start on January 1. It starts this Sunday. Advent begins Nov 29: 4 weeks to slow down and make room for Christ. Open a door each day on our Advent calendar: catholicdoorway.com/advent #Advent #Catholic

image.title: Advent Begins
image.body: Four weeks to slow down, pray, and prepare room for Christ. Open a new door each day.

coach.why: A surprising, true fact most people don't know, with a simple daily habit as the payoff.
fixes: Post the Advent calendar link again on Sunday morning as a reminder.
